title: ever HARLEY|Romantic V-neck Lace Bodice Wedding Guest Dress with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Scrolling for a unique dress with pockets that is hard to resist for a charismatic look? Then this party prom dress is perfect to order immediately. Its sheer bodice has a romantic charming appearance with appealing cut-work short cap-sleeves and zig-zag-edged V-neckline. The slimming waist belt is adorned with symmetrical multiple plates paired with a lace bodice enough to guarantee a charming look on your special day. The knee-length skirt flaring gracefully from the fitted waist adds delicacy to your perfect figure. Grab this romantically appealing dress and pair it up with stylish earrings and a classy clutch for a matchless look at any party, prom, wedding, or any big day.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Midi length.

 

Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded. No Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester  
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
